response.original_title: Bang, Bang! An American Horror Movie
response.overview: What's a girl to do when her life (boyfriend, apartment, job, pregnancy) is built on lies and denial and is now crashing down? Mary Jane stops taking her meds and gets a gun. Reality and mental illness collide as she plunges into madness and random violence. The world that hurt her had better watch out.
response.title: Bang, Bang! An American Horror Movie
